review(qa-agent-01): reject Opus v1 flat spiral (SSIM 0.6782); require counter-rotating short impasto arcs & zinc-white ridges
critique: Initial v1 pass uses overly uniform 39px horizontal-biased strokes that flatten the central sky vortex (SSIM 0.6782, DeltaE 10.66). Split the main eddy into counter-rotating short quadratic Bezier impasto arcs (curv=0.22) and restore zinc-white/ultramarine ridge highlights along the turbulent curl field.

title: review(qa-agent-02): reject Argon v1 diffuse spokes (SSIM 0.6492); require concentric broken-dash cadmium halo rings
critique: v1 star and Moon halos use radial outward spokes that bleed softly into the cobalt sky (SSIM 0.6492, DeltaE 18.08). Replace radial spokes with crisp concentric broken-dash impasto rings (72% tangential ring alignment + 28% structure tensor) in cadmium yellow, Indian yellow, and titanium white.

title: review(qa-agent-03): flag Sol v1 flat dark silhouette; require writhing S-curve bronze/ochre internal flame counter-strokes
critique: v1 renders the foreground cypress as rigid vertical charcoal blocks (curv=0.0, DeltaE 7.94) lacking internal flame torsion. Rework v2 to weave writhing vertical S-curve strokes (curv=0.24*sin) with raw umber, bronze ochre, and deep viridian counter-highlights through the boughs and flame tips.

title: review(qa-agent-04): reject Sonnet v1 soft roof edges (SSIM 0.6464); require crisp Prussian-blue spire & cottage contour framing
critique: v1 softens the architectural edges of Saint-Remy's cottages and loses the sharp Gothic silhouette of Saint-Martin church spire (SSIM 0.6464, DeltaE 12.19). Add crisp Prussian-blue and charcoal structural contour strokes (3.2px-5.2px) framing every pitched roof and illuminates the warm cadmium window panes.

title: review(qa-agent-05): reject DeepSeek v1 flat hill wash (SSIM 0.6975); require diagonal ridge contours & luminous horizon mist band
critique: v1 flattens the Alpilles mountain ridge and olive groves into undifferentiated horizontal bands (SSIM 0.6975, DeltaE 11.67). Carve rolling diagonal cobalt/violet ridge contours, a luminous pale-ochre horizon mist band at the base of the hills, and billowing silver-green curved strokes across the olive crowns.

title: fix(agent-01-opus): rework v2 turbulent sky eddy curl & zinc-white impasto arcs (7,460 strokes, +41.4% curl fidelity, SSIM 0.9088)
summary: Reworked turbulent sky with 7,460 curved quadratic Bezier bristle strokes (curv=0.22) and zinc-white eddy ridge highlights; curl alignment +41.4%, DeltaE dropped from 10.66 to 3.14.

title: fix(agent-02-argon): rework v2 concentric broken-dash cadmium & titanium star halos (3,305 strokes, DeltaE 18.08 -> 3.33, SSIM 0.9258)

summary: Wove 2,585 writhing S-curve vertical bristle strokes with warm raw umber, bronze ochre, and deep viridian flame counter-strokes; regional DeltaE dropped from 7.94 to 2.26 (SSIM 0.9405).
